opaque_agent_id_status: unavailable in retained parent context; not fabricated
intended_claim: weak relational reconstruction improves fixed512D donor-heldout MacroF1 over original_h and equal-budget MSE continuation
confidence_scope: High confidence in the descriptive within-protocol conclusion; no confirmatory generalization asserted.
what_results_support: The predeclared weak direct-reconstruction candidate did not improve the pooled donor mean over either original_h or matched-MSE.
Strong lambda0.3 has higher mean scores in a predeclared secondary analysis, with substantial donor concentration and only3/6 positive donors.
MSE continuation improves over old20 by0.4423pp descriptively, but remains0.0462pp below original_h; this bundles multiple training changes.
All methods really changed trainable parameters; geometry/training diagnostics are computed, not evidence of biological mechanism.
what_results_dont_support: The intended primary weak-relation benefit or gate advancement.
Promoting strong/fixed_half to the primary method after TEST inspection.
Independent-cohort, causal-biological, significance, equivalence, convergence, duration-only or general SAE-benefit/uselessness claims.
Treating preservation of frozen model geometry as biological ground truth or as new observed information.
missing_evidence: Independent cohort/donor confirmation of a prospectively fixed strong-arm hypothesis.
Stronger non-SAE nonlinear/denoising controls before an SAE-specific explanation.
Separate duration/sampling/optimizer/schedule controls before attributing old20-vs-MSE effects solely to training duration.
Independent biological perturbation evidence before mechanism claims.
suggested_claim_revision: 在历史探索性 Kang 六供体、三个配对 seed、固定 1000 次额外更新下，预设弱关系约束（λ=0.03）的直接重建 Macro-F1 为82.5805%，相对原始 h 为−0.1734 pp、相对等预算 MSE 为−0.1272 pp，未支持主假设或通过预设推进门槛。次要强约束（λ=0.3）达到83.4752%，平均分别提高0.7213和0.7675 pp；但仅3/6供体在两项比较中改善，原始 h 对比明显受 patient_1016 影响，去掉该供体的描述性均值为−0.1017 pp。强约束可作为待独立验证的探索性信号，不能按 TEST 结果替换主候选；本结果也不证明 SAE 普遍无用。
next_experiments_needed: No new experiments in this completed fixed protocol. If a new study is later authorized, lock strong lambda and its primary endpoint before independent-cohort evaluation, with donor-level consistency and comparable controls.
routing_action: stop_current_fixed_protocol; record unsupported primary and qualified secondary signal; no retuning or automatic supplementary training
